meaning: Number of order-item rows in the order.
Number of distinct products in the order.
Number of distinct sellers contributing items to the order.
1 when at least one item in the order has no recorded price, so no order total exists; otherwise 0.
Sum of repaired item prices in the order, in Brazilian reais. Set to 0 when total_item_price_missing is 1, where the indicator rather than the value carries the information.
1 when at least one item in the order has no recorded freight charge, so no order total exists; otherwise 0.
Sum of repaired item freight charges in the order, in Brazilian reais. Set to 0 when total_freight_value_missing is 1, where the indicator rather than the value carries the information.
1 when at least one item in the order has no recorded product weight, so no order weight exists; otherwise 0.
Sum of repaired product weights across the items in the order, in grams. Set to 0 when total_product_weight_g_missing is 1.
1 when at least one item in the order has no recorded product dimensions, so no order volume exists; otherwise 0.
Sum of repaired product volumes across the items in the order, in cubic centimetres. Set to 0 when total_product_volume_cm3_missing is 1.
1 when no item in the order has a recorded listing photo count; otherwise 0.
Mean listing photo count across the items in the order. Set to 0 when avg_product_photos_qty_missing is 1.
Number of distinct product categories in the order. 0 when no item has a known category.
1 when every item with a known seller state ships from the customer's own state; otherwise 0.
1 when no item in the order has a valid seller state, so shipment origin cannot be determined; otherwise 0.
Elapsed hours from order purchase to approval.
Days from approval to the estimated delivery timestamp.
Sine encoding of approval time within the 24-hour daily cycle.
Cosine encoding of approval time within the 24-hour daily cycle.
Sine encoding of approval weekday within the seven-day weekly cycle.
Cosine encoding of approval weekday within the seven-day weekly cycle.
Sine encoding of approval month within the annual cycle.
Cosine encoding of approval month within the annual cycle.
